comment: Minimum dataset graded by the AMD skills catalog. Cases that profile a sample and read the report live in extended_evals.json.

evaluations.prompt: should I use stochastic or host trap PC sampling on this GPU?
expected_behavior: explains that only stochastic records a stall reason
notes stochastic needs MI300 or newer and host_trap is the fallback
checks what the installed device actually supports

evaluations.prompt: my host trap PC sampling run has no stall reasons, how do I interpret them?
expected_behavior: explains that host_trap records no stall reason
offers stochastic sampling if the device supports it
unexpected_behavior: interprets a stall reason from host-trap data

evaluations.note: Catalog trigger check. The profiled version is pcs-which-instruction-stalls in extended_evals.json.
evaluations.prompt: which instruction in my AMD GPU kernel stalls the most, and what is the stall reason?

evaluations.note: Hotspot wording, but ranking whole kernels is counter work, not instruction sampling.
evaluations.prompt: which of my GPU kernels accounts for the most total time?
profile my C++ program's CPU hotspots with perf
do instruction level sampling on my CUDA kernel
